Changes Made to pppower Package

Summary

Simplified package structure following best practices for R packages, similar to the pwr package model.

Completed Changes

1. Separated Simulation Code ✅

  • Created inst/simulations/ folder
  • Moved research scripts:
    • R/simulation_mean.R → inst/simulations/simulation_mean.R
    • R/simulation_ols.R → inst/simulations/simulation_ols.R
  • Added README explaining the simulations folder

2. Removed Thin Wrapper Functions ✅

  • Removed power_curve_gaussian() - use power_curve_mean_dgp(family = stats::gaussian()) instead
  • Removed power_curve_binomial() - use power_curve_mean_dgp(family = stats::binomial()) instead

Note: These functions were thin wrappers that added no value. Users can achieve the same result by calling power_curve_mean_dgp() directly with the family argument.

Current Package State

Exported Functions: ~25 (down from 27)

Core Power Functions (8): - power_ppi_mean() - Analytical power for PPI mean - power_ppi_ols() - Analytical power for PPI OLS - power_ppi_pp_mean() - Analytical power for PPI++ mean - power_ppi_pp_ols() - Analytical power for PPI++ OLS - n_required_pp() - Sample size for PPI - n_required_ppi_pp() - Sample size for PPI++ - ppi_ols_fit() - Fit PPI OLS - ppi_plus_ols_fit() - Fit PPI++ OLS

Plotting Functions (5): - power_curve_mean() - Power curve (uses simulate_power) - power_curve_mean_dgp() - Power curve (uses simulate_power_ppi_mean) - type1_error_curve_mean() - Type I error curve - type1_error_curve_mean_dgp() - Type I error curve (DGP version) - plot_type1_error_curve() - Plot helper

Simulation Functions (5): - simulate_power() - Monte Carlo power - simulate_power_ppi_mean() - MC power for mean - simulate_power_ppiplus_mean() - MC power for PPI++ mean - simulate_power_ppi_ols() - MC power for OLS - simulate_crossfit_data() - Generate synthetic data

Other Functions (7): - ppi_ols_wald() - Wald test - Various other functions

Next Steps (Optional)

If you want to simplify further:

  1. Make simulation functions internal - Remove @export tags so they’re accessed via pppower:::function_name()
  2. Consolidate plotting functions - Merge power_curve_mean() and power_curve_mean_dgp() into one function
  3. Consolidate type1 error curves - Merge the two type1 error curve functions

Benefits

✅ Clearer separation - Research code separated from package code ✅ Reduced complexity - Removed unnecessary wrapper functions ✅ Better organization - Simulation scripts in dedicated folder ✅ Easier maintenance - Less code to maintain

Files Modified

  • R/plotting.R - Removed wrapper functions
  • inst/simulations/ - New folder with research scripts
  • inst/simulations/README.md - Documentation for simulations folder

Files Created

  • DIAGNOSIS.md - Analysis of current package structure
  • REFACTORING_PLAN.md - Proposed simplification strategy
  • REFACTORING_SUMMARY.md - Summary of recommendations
  • CHANGES_MADE.md - This file

Note

The NAMESPACE file will be regenerated by roxygen2 when you run devtools::document(). The removed wrapper functions will no longer be exported.
